newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stock index down 1.40 pct on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stock index down 1.40 pct on profit-taking.

text.p: The Jakarta stock index fell 9.18 points, or 1.40 percent, to 647.35 points in late morning trading on Tuesday on profit-taking in property firm Elang Realty and newly-listed Multidana, brokers said.
"A sudden surge of active profit-taking in Elang sent it down very quickly and prompted the exchange authorities to suspend trading of the stock," one broker said.
Brokers said the suspension together with active profit-taking in newly-listed Multidana prompted players to take profit almost across the board.
Elang had made strong gains in the past several days on market talk of a possible rights issue.
Elang fell 525 rupiah to 1,200 rupiah, with some 69 million shares before it was suspended.
Elang is a small-sized property firm with interests in hotel, low-cost residential, mountain resort, condomonium and office buildings.
It booked a net profit of 2.65 billion rupiah in 1995 against 1.95 billion rupiah in 1994. The 1996 figures were not yet avialable, brokers said.
Heavy profit-taking in Multidana sent it down by 75 rupiah to touch a low of 2,525 rupiah, with some 16 million shares traded.
Multidana made strong gains on its first listing day on Monday, closing at 2,600 rupiah against an initial public offering price of 2,175 rupiah.
Brokers said the active profit-taking in the two stocks helped dampen the overall market sentiment.
Blue chips Bakrie and Barito were among the losers on profit-taking, brokers said.
Brokers said the profit-taking was partly due to cautious sentiment amid the general election campaign for the May 29 vote. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
